_purpose: The frozen fold map: the syndicate-to-fold assignment every cross-validation and every backtest in this repository uses (oos_validation.fold_assignment reads it). A syndicate absent from the map is refused, and a population that lacks some syndicates simply has fewer. Dealt once; never redealt, so that removing a syndicate or a record never moves another syndicate to another fold.
dealing_rule: the syndicates sorted by number and dealt out in turn: position i is the syndicate's rank in that order (0-based) and its fold at k folds is i mod k (k = 5 for the by-syndicate cross-validations, k = 10 for the operator backtest). A whole syndicate's years are in one fold

dealt_on.sample: the 643-record included-data working sample from 118 syndicates: model/exposure_results.json as committed at c6f90750 (adopted_model.load_sample), whose syndicate set is also the included-data base of check_exclusion_influence.py
